exposure: German version of the Birth Satisfaction Scale-Revised (Ger-BSS-R)
outcome: Psychometric properties of the Ger-BSS-R (confirmatory factor analysis, internal consistency)
Sub-scale scores (quality of care provision, women's personal attributes, stress experienced during labor)
cohort: The study included 248 women with pre-existing medical conditions who completed the Ger-BSS-R during their hospital inpatient stay for childbirth.
finding: The Ger-BSS-R is a robust instrument for assessing birth satisfaction, and its tri-dimensional measurement model showed a good fit to the data, though some internal consistency values were lower than the founder UK version.
cross-section timing: During hospital inpatient stay for childbirth
